visualCharacteristics: Full-width 2560x480 promo photo (red Christmas panel left, Apple HomeView device right) with H1, subline and white pill CTA overlaid on the left. The photo background belongs to the hero block, so the section is not colored.
contentPattern:
Text overlaid on a full-bleed promotional photo is a hero; the photo background is owned by the block.

Full-bleed wide promo photo with text and pill CTA overlaid on the left half.
usage: Top-of-page promotional banner: one full-bleed photo with an H1, short offer text and a CTA overlaid on the left.
reuseGuidance: Use for campaign/promo heroes where the photo fills the block and text sits on the left half. Row 1: background image. Row 2: heading, text, CTA link (bold link = primary button). Extra or merged cells are tolerated; the first image is always the background.
tableStructure: H1 heading, offer paragraph, CTA link
